result.rationale: Correct the existing production record to the bounded 24-facility Cleveland Clinic sale-leaseback portfolio. Direct manager and title evidence supports Fengate and MedCraft Healthcare Real Estate as current joint owners at undisclosed stakes, Cleveland Clinic as the former fee owner and continuing tenant/operator, and a September 2025 closed transaction. This portfolio remains distinct from the Fengate-Montecito Project Lotus investment, and no later owner exit or signed transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.

evidence.purpose: Direct manager evidence for the Fengate-MedCraft joint venture, 24-facility scope, geography and completed acquisition.
Contemporaneous evidence for Cleveland Clinic as seller and tenant, MedCraft as buyer, transfer timing and title vehicles.
Government title evidence for transfer into the FG MC II ownership structure.
